mapper.insert: MERGE INTO byai_group_chat_message_ack target USING ( SELECT CAST(#{sessionId} AS BIGINT) AS session_id, CAST(#{messageId} AS BIGINT) AS message_id, CAST(#{userId} AS BIGINT) AS user_id, CAST(#{userName} AS VARCHAR) AS user_name, CAST(#{acknowledgedAt} AS TIMESTAMP) AS acknowledged_at ) source ON (target.session_id = source.session_id AND target.message_id = source.message_id AND target.user_id = source.user_id) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( session_id, message_id, user_id, user_name, acknowledged_at ) VALUES ( source.session_id, source.message_id, source.user_id, source.user_name, source.acknowledged_at )
